entities.name: Flavohemoprotein candidate
observations: 415-aa sequence matches reviewed bacterial flavohemoproteins across nearly its full length; best hit Q7UIY1 has 64.5% identity and 98.1% query coverage.
Sequence carries globin, FAD-binding, and NAD-binding domain signatures.
Close curated homologs bind heme b and FAD and are annotated as oxygen-dependent nitric oxide dioxygenases.

entities.name: NO dioxygenation to nitrate
observations: Homolog reaction: 2 nitric oxide + NADPH + 2 O2 = 2 nitrate + NADP(+) + H(+); Rhea RHEA:19465.
Homolog reaction: 2 nitric oxide + NADH + 2 O2 = 2 nitrate + NAD(+) + H(+); Rhea RHEA:19469.
